entities.name: Query protein (479 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 479 aa; estimated molecular mass is 48.99 kDa.
Theoretical pI is 4.61 and predicted charge at pH 7 is approximately -26.8, indicating an acidic protein.
Pfam scanning detects YjeF_N (PF03853.22) at residues 33–182 and Carb_kinase (PF01256.23) at residues 229–468.
Strongest homologs are reviewed archaeal bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes Nnr, with 30.7–32.8% identity and 94.2–96.5% query coverage.
Likely function, inferred from homology and matching domain architecture, is NAD(P)HX epimerase plus ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase.
Reference Nnr proteins bind one potassium ion per subunit and have EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136 annotations; transfer to this sequence remains homology-based.
Candidate reactions are NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration regenerating NAD(P)H or NAD(P)H and producing AMP plus phosphate.
Associated GO terms in homologs include NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, metabolite repair, and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
No transmembrane segments or signal peptide were reported; a soluble intracellular enzyme is therefore plausible but not experimentally established.

Functional annotation evidence grade is limited_homology_support; exact substrate specificity, oligomeric state, localization, and catalytic residues are not experimentally established for the query sequence.

They catalyze NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX in curated UniProt annotations.
